title: 在一条赛道 感知城市“国际影响力”（2025 上马复盘，上海市政府网转载解放日报）
publisher: 上海市人民政府门户网站（解放日报）
claims: The 2025 field numbered 23,000 full-marathon runners; the overall finish rate was 98.02% and international runners made up 13.3% of the field.
Pre-entry drew 356,600 registrations with a ballot odds of 7.2%; the 2025 race used three gun starts and extended the finish cut-off to 13:30.
Men's winner Milkesa Mengesha ran 2:06:25; Brigid Kosgei won the women's in 2:16:36, lowering the women's course record by about four minutes; the wheelchair title was defended by a local athlete.
Domestic men's first was Feng Peiyou and domestic women's first was Zhang Deshun, her fourth consecutive domestic women's title at Shanghai.
The race covered 43 medical stations and 36监护 ambulances; more than 30% of entrants were non-local or overseas runners.

Organisers announced that the 2026 Shanghai Marathon would be held on 6 December 2026 with registration opening no later than the end of April 2026; a 5 km healthy run would be staged separately on 5 December 2026.
